candidates.title: FailSafe: High-performance Resilient Serving
candidates.reason: Fault-tolerant tensor-parallel serving with cyclic KV placement, hybrid attention, load-aware routing, proactive KV backup and on-demand weight recovery; 8xH100 evaluation reports up to 2x throughput and two orders lower recovery latency under failures.

candidates.title: LUMEN: Coordinated Failure Recovery for Distributed LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Treats distributed LLM recovery as load-aware coordination across checkpoint placement, interrupted-request redistribution and capacity restoration during model reload; combines prototype experiments and large-scale simulations.

candidates.title: HW-Router: Hardware-Aware Routing for Scalable Multi-LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Dynamic multi-LLM routing using real-time queue, KV utilization and TTFT/TPOT hardware signals; reports 3.4-3.9x lower end-to-end latency and 46-48 percentage-point higher SLO attainment with released code.

discovery_stats.query_summary: heterogeneous GPU schedulingからfailure recoveryとruntime hardware-aware routingへ切り替えた。FailSafe、LUMEN、HW-Routerはいずれも明確なserving-system寄与を持ち、default branchのcanonical ID/title検索で未収録を確認した。
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: KV compression/reuse systemの2025 omissions、then batching/admission control、then framework-specific runtime systemsへ移る
